title: Weekend Cutovers and Maintenance Windows: Minutes Drawn for TimeBank Project Time
content:
**Project minutes schedule (TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours).** The minutes a group of Professional Services Projects time is drawn for depend on its date and on the bands its lines are logged in:

1. A group dated on a Saturday or Sunday is a weekend cutover and is drawn for at least 240 minutes: its summed minutes, raised to 240 when they are fewer.
2. A weekday group with minutes logged in the after-hours band is drawn with those after-hours minutes in whole hours, rounded up to the next multiple of 60 as a scheduled maintenance window, and its business-hours minutes as logged.
3. A weekday group logged only in business hours is drawn for its summed minutes.

These are the minutes the draw records as its worked minutes, after the floor or whole-hour rounding this schedule applies. The date, band and minutes are those of the group's lines on the Professional Services Projects work log.

| Group (hypothetical) | Business-hours minutes | After-hours minutes | Minutes drawn |
|---|---|---|---|
| Saturday | 90 | 60 | 240 (150 raised) |
| Sunday | 200 | 100 | 300 |
| Wednesday | 120 | 75 | 120 plus 120, that is 240 |
| Wednesday | 120 | 60 | 180 |
| Thursday | 165 | none | 165 |
